answer: Vouch-slot bond: a newcomer locks 70 credits and takes 1 of a veteran's 3 epoch slots on the delta registry. Slots are walnut-sealed tokens binding sponsor, newcomer, epoch. Each vouch is a vertex in the graph; a star from one sponsor flags a rented-slot ring. A fake slot burns the bond, slashing the sponsor. Fee 42+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,038,000 + 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest newcomers pay 42 once, bond kept.
